HYS Flanges Co. Ltd
HYS Flanges Co. Ltd specializes in producing flanges and fittings for all types of applications. Our products serve oil and gas, refining, power generation, construction, shipbuilding, offshore engineering, machinery, chemical processing, palm oil, biodiesel, and other industries worldwide.
